headline: PiS wants to dictate to banks how they should calculate loans. There is a draft bill
summary: Law and Justice party leaders announced a draft amendment to banking law requiring banks and SKOK credit unions to include benefits such as 800 plus, alimony, rents and pensions in creditworthiness calculations. Such income is currently sometimes excluded.
why: Creditworthiness rules determine how much households can borrow from banks. Changes to these rules affect lending volumes and bank risk models.
original_headline: PiS chce dyktować bankom, jak mają liczyć kredyty. Jest projekt
